description: The createRecord request body is an anyOf of one object per record type (A, AAAA, ALIAS, CAA, CNAME, MX, SRV, TXT, NS, HTTPS). Convert keeps only the members declared outside the union, so the generated CreateRecordRequest has `type` alone, and a typed call cannot send `name`, `value`, `ttl`, `mxPriority`, `srv`, `https` or `comment`. Each variant requires a different subset (`name` for all; `value` for A, AAAA, ALIAS, CAA, MX and TXT; `mxPriority` for MX; `srv` and `https` for their own types), so this adds the union members to the input as optional fields. Live probe (2026-11-11, throwaway Vercel DNS zone, deleted afterwards): `{"type":"MX"}` answered 400 `bad_request` "Invalid request: missing required property `name`."; MX with `mxPriority` and `comment`, SRV with `srv`, and HTTPS with `https` each answered 200 with a `uid`, and reading the records back returned the sent values. Vercel's Terraform provider sends the same fields to this endpoint (https://github.com/vercel/terraform-provider-vercel/blob/152fffc2d661ac6b1583496635804d5107b45037/client/dns_record.go, CreateDNSRecordRequest).

traits.smithy.api#documentation: A subdomain name or an empty string for the root domain.
The record value. Required for A, AAAA, ALIAS, CAA, MX and TXT records.
The TTL value. Must be a number between 60 and 2147483647. Default value is 60.
The MX priority value. Required for MX records.
A comment to add context on what this DNS record is for
